displayName: Nextier Auto Beta Stage Summary V1
description: One row per processed beta Auto stage with landmark/window metadata for lineage, QA, and dashboard drilldown.
sql: SELECT CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS auto_stage_uid, fleet_name, pad_name, name AS well_name, id AS well_id, api_num, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS stage_num, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS copper_continuous, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS stage_start_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS stage_end_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS source_min_record_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS source_max_record_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS open_well_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS auto_stage_start_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS ttr_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS auto_stage_end_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS close_well_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS rampdown_trigger_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS last_pump_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS pad_start_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS pad_end_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS slurry_start_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS slurry_end_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS flush_start_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS flush_end_ts, CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS stage_closed, CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS mid_confirmed, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS stage_start_source, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS concentration_feature, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS conc_col, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS resolved_design_rate, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS source_row_count, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS label_row_count, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS source_signature, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS algorithm_version, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS source_mode, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS processed_at FROM datastore:merged_fleet_stream_customer_full_v2 WHERE 1 = 0
